scope: S8 final integrated measurement; experimental elapsed comparison, no source/native/resource/semantic qualification credit
frozen_at: 2026-10-31, before any S8 campaign sample (exploratory single samples from builds 1-3 exist and are excluded from this campaign)

method.execution: fresh processes; 8 GiB address-space cap; zero core size; heavy-run outer

cohorts.gnu: GNU Emacs 31.1 bytecode via the recorded emacs-gnu wrapper (BENCH_ENGINE=gnu) and the recorded GNU-capable drivers
cohorts.old: recorded r3 ON image fe7f6b1e308725b765b9e32e63f702311182fb5b2e6aafc9df9facd908dc951e via the recorded lane_runner.py and drivers (not rebuilt)
cohorts.new: final method-A ON image built from the merged worktree; drivers repinned only in frozen12 paths and image hash (repin.sh); same bwrap lane runner semantics

method_difference: new is built by method A (entry run directly, not the recorded authenticated adapter route); report as such

thresholds.improvement: target row passes when new median kernel time is at least 10% lower than old at the same N
thresholds.regression: any row with new median kernel time more than 5% above old at the same N fails
thresholds.whole_process: every whole-process regression is reported; more than 5% blocks acceptance pending explicit review
thresholds.code_growth: report nc_ function size old vs new for changed kernels; more than 10% growth per changed unit is flagged
thresholds.semantics: every sample must have rc 0, route=named-fx-default for NeLisp cohorts, validated BENCH-CHECK, empty stderr; any failure invalidates the row

controls: BENCH_BROKEN=1 must fail validation for old and new
guard fset/restore runtime checks re-run on the final image
phase-event cohort (S2) re-run on the final image as a separate table
reporting: kernel and whole-process seconds in separate columns, signed percent changes, all rows including regressions, raw samples retained, independent non-Fable review of pins/data/claims
